request.subject: UNIT:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn it into a small old-fashioned wooden submarine: the open hull becomes one closed fat cigar-shaped hull of the same pale straw-yellow birch planks with light steel bands and two round glass portholes; remove the mast and the sail; on top a short round conning tower painted bright red with a thin steel periscope and the small red pennant; a red tail fin at the stern. Keep the hull's place, waterline, size, thick black outline and style, with nothing under the hull.
